prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D side-scrolling game enemy sprite poses on a genuinely transparent PNG. Create a NEW original character for a cheerful pastel storybook kingdom called Merong Kingdom (merong means playfully sticking your tongue out). Subject: a small mint-turquoise plump royal tongue sentry, cheeky harmless-looking monster with a HUGE dark plum mouth, pink lips, tiny white tooth, rosy cheek, one visible lively dark eye, short rounded feet, and a little golden three-point crown tilted on top. Full body RIGHT FACING side profile, rounded silhouette, soft hand-painted gouache/cartoon shading, rich teal outlines, light upper-left, pink and gold accents. Match a colorful children's fantasy platformer with lime trees, pink flowers and a peach-sky palace. It should be a mischievous enemy, not scary, not a frog, not a ghost. Compose EXACTLY SIX isolated poses of the SAME character in a uniform 3 columns x 2 rows grid, evenly spaced generous transparent gutters, each character wholly inside its equal grid cell, same scale and feet baseline in every cell. Reading order: 1 relaxed open mouth with tongue hidden; 2 warning cheeks puffed, surprised raised brow; 3 attack mouth wide open to RIGHT with only a very short pink tongue nub (the game draws the long tongue); 4 recovery with droopy eyelid and a little tongue tip; 5 idle blinking eye closed; 6 stronger warning cheeks inflated and brow determined. Keep open mouth at approximately the same right-side location and height in all poses. Feet and whole crown visible. No background, no floor, no shadows outside the silhouette, no labels, no lettering, no borders, no weapons, no other characters, no checkerboard. This is a usable transparent pose sheet, not a scene or presentation.
